notes.zh-CN:
WePic 首次公开发布。
支持 Windows 与 macOS，提供一致的看图操作。
支持 Live Photo 与动态照片播放，照片和视频在同一窗口浏览。
支持本地 OCR 和图上划词，识别后直接选中、复制文字。
支持图片翻译，可使用自备 API 配置在线翻译。
支持图片编辑标注、动图逐帧查看、文件夹浏览及深浅主题。
提供 Windows 安装包与 Mac Apple Silicon 安装包。
支持在应用内检查更新、下载更新包和查看更新说明。
下载更新支持完整性校验和中断续传；Mac 更新清单使用发布者签名校验。
notes.en-US:
Initial public release of WePic.
Available on Windows and macOS with familiar viewing controls on both platforms.
Play Live Photos and motion photos, and browse photos and videos in one window.
Recognize text locally with OCR, then select and copy it directly from images.
Translate images online using your own API configuration.
Edit and annotate images, inspect animated images frame by frame, browse folders, and switch between light and dark themes.
Installers are available for Windows and Apple Silicon Macs.
Check for updates, download update packages, and read release notes inside the app.
Update downloads support integrity checks and resuming; Mac update manifests are verified with the publisher’s signature.
